content.title: How Recent Analyst Resets Are Reframing The Leslie's (LESL) Investment Story
content.summary: Leslie's latest analyst reset has been harsh, with model fair value estimates moving from about US$8.90 to roughly US$5.53 and published price targets shifting down to US$5 from US$20 after the company issued new earnings results and guidance. That swing reflects revenue assumptions that now move from a 56.6% growth outlook to a 73.2% decline, as analysts bring expectations closer to what they see in the current guidance and execution. Stay tuned as we walk through what changed in the story...

content.summary: Pool products retailer Leslie’s (NASDAQ:LESL) reported Q3 CY2025 results topping the market’s revenue expectations, but sales fell by 2.2% year on year to $389.2 million. On the other hand, the company’s full-year revenue guidance of $1.18 billion at the midpoint came in 4.4% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.09 per share was 93.1% below analysts’ consensus estimates.
